order: Resolve the project before milestones, issues, or documents.
Use list_issues with project and team filters for task discovery.
Use get_project(query, includeMilestones:true) for milestone context.
Pass both milestone and resolved project when assigning a milestone.
project_resolution.strict_project: Reject an entity outside the selected project.
project_resolution.cross_project_blockers: Read-only external blocker context; never expands mutation scope.

steps: Obtain approval for that mutation unless the user already approved it explicitly.
Re-read the logical target and compare its revision or relevant fields.
Validate the command and any state transition with scripts/linear_spanks_cli.py state advance.
Use an idempotency key derived from project, entity, command, and current revision; bulk operations add a stable operation ID and canonical payload hash from state payload-hash.
Apply only intended fields; omit empty optional fields.
Read back the saved entity or document; plan it with runtime readback-plan and read back only the written fields plus identity and revision.
Report the artifact title, status, and Linear link.

assurance_variance.strict: Re-read before every write and read back every write.
assurance_variance.balanced: Reuse the revision within the logical entity or phase unless drift is detected; trust the mutation response as acknowledgement but still perform one explicit final entity read.

never: Mutate during a read-only or report request.
Expand scope, bulk-create, apply review fixes, persist learning artifacts, archive, split, promote, or resolve conflicts without the manifest's explicit gate.

postcondition_definitions.each_write_read_back: After each write, issue a fresh read and confirm the intended fields are present. A projected read of the written fields plus identity and revision satisfies this; a full entity read is never required to prove a write landed. A mutation response is an acknowledgement, not evidence.
postcondition_definitions.all_writes_read_back: Every write in this command must be confirmed by a fresh read before the command reports success.
postcondition_definitions.every_write_read_back: Every write in this command must be confirmed by a fresh read before the command reports success.
postcondition_definitions.each_linear_write_read_back: Every Linear mutation must be confirmed by a fresh Linear read before reporting success.
postcondition_definitions.phase_writes_read_back: Reconcile the phase once, then perform targeted reads for failures, missing entities, and stale revisions.
postcondition_definitions.done_state_read_back: After setting Done, re-read the issue and confirm the status actually persisted as Done.
postcondition_definitions.completion_receipt_read_back: Re-read the persisted completion comment and confirm its content matches what was written.
postcondition_definitions.state_marker_read_back: Re-read the milestone description and confirm the machine-readable state marker holds the intended stage.
postcondition_definitions.plan_revision_read_back: Re-read the persisted Implementation Plan comment and confirm the plan revision advanced as intended.
postcondition_definitions.description_and_status_read_back: Re-read both the entity description and its status after writing them.
postcondition_definitions.backlog_status_read_back: Re-read the issue and confirm it reached Backlog only after its authoritative plan was persisted.
postcondition_definitions.gate_done_read_back: Re-read the human-verification gate issue and confirm it is Done.
postcondition_definitions.snapshot_document_read_back: Re-read the persisted snapshot Document and confirm its content and revision.
postcondition_definitions.verification_receipt_read_back: Re-read the persisted verification result comment before treating verification as recorded.
postcondition_definitions.repair_task_read_back: Re-read the created repair task and confirm it exists with the intended contract.
postcondition_definitions.release_update_read_back: Re-read the project after a release update and confirm the change persisted.
postcondition_definitions.human_verified_marker_read_back: Re-read the milestone state marker and confirm it records human-verified.
postcondition_definitions.linear_completion_read_back: Re-read the Linear entity after completion and confirm the terminal state persisted.
postcondition_definitions.successor_entities_read_back: Re-read every created successor entity and confirm it exists before resolving the source.
postcondition_definitions.enabled_checklist_and_gate_read_back: Re-read both the checklist and the gate issue after enabling human verification.
postcondition_definitions.integrated_issues_done_and_read_back: Confirm by fresh read that every integrated issue reached Done.
postcondition_definitions.every_created_task_unplanned_and_read_ba: Confirm by fresh read that each created task exists and is in Unplanned.
postcondition_definitions.snapshot_read_back_before_active_referen: Persist and read back the snapshot before writing the small active reference that points at it.
postcondition_definitions.archive_read_back_before_comment_mutatio: Persist the archive Document and confirm it by fresh read before mutating or deleting any source comment.
postcondition_definitions.canonical_comments_read_back_before_any_: Confirm every canonical per-type comment by fresh read before deleting any redundant comment.
postcondition_definitions.canonical_comments_and_summary_read_back: Confirm the canonical comments and the milestone summary by fresh read before any deletion.
postcondition_definitions.deleted_comment_ids_absent_on_fresh_comp: Prove absence from a fresh complete comment inventory. A delete acknowledgement is not proof, and a permissions error or ambiguous lookup is not absence.
postcondition_definitions.original_comment_versions_preserved_in_s: All original comment versions must survive in exactly one archive Document before consolidation.
postcondition_definitions.original_comment_and_task_versions_prese: All original comment and task versions must survive in exactly one archive Document before consolidation.
postcondition_definitions.exact_preview_approval_satisfied: The approval must name this exact preview. A general approval never satisfies it.
postcondition_definitions.exact_preview_hash_approved: The approved preview hash must equal the current preview hash; any drift invalidates the approval.
postcondition_definitions.exact_repair_preview_approved: The approval must name this exact repair preview.
postcondition_definitions.preview_hash_approval: Activation requires approval bound to the exact preview hash.
postcondition_definitions.prune_never_inferred_or_inherited: Pruning requires an explicit --level prune argument on this invocation. It is never inferred from general approval, execution permission, configuration, a parent loop, or a previous checkpoint.
postcondition_definitions.unapproved_operations_omitted: Operations outside the approved preview must not be performed.
postcondition_definitions.stronger_model_selection_user_gated: A stronger executor runs only after explicit user model selection bound to the current attempt count.
postcondition_definitions.verification_passed: Every acceptance criterion passes, no blocking findings are open or regressed, the exact candidate commit was reviewed, and all required checks were freshly rerun.
postcondition_definitions.unverified_work_not_marked_done: Work without current verification evidence must not reach Done.
postcondition_definitions.no_done_without_verified_integration: Done requires a validated integration receipt for the exact candidate.
postcondition_definitions.failed_verification_remains_in_progress: On failure, record a Verification Failure comment and keep or move the task to In Progress. Never advance to Done.
postcondition_definitions.machine_reverification_required: Machine verification must be rerun; a prior pass on a different candidate does not carry over.
postcondition_definitions.fresh_human_checklist_required: A new revision-bound human checklist is required; a previous checklist does not carry over.
postcondition_definitions.no_mutations: This command performs no writes of any kind.
postcondition_definitions.read_only_when_no_approved_mutation: Without an approved mutation this command must behave as read-only.
postcondition_definitions.source_tree_unmodified: This role must not edit tracked source.
postcondition_definitions.role_capabilities_enforced: Each role may perform only its contract-defined operations; workers never mutate Linear beyond their own marked comment.
postcondition_definitions.hard_blockers_done: Every hard blocker must be Done before execution proceeds.
postcondition_definitions.required_links_reported: Report the artifact title, status, and Linear link for each affected entity.

naming: Read the project's naming-conventions paragraph before proposing milestones or issues and apply it strictly. During audit or onboarding, report a missing convention and ask for the preferred format before saving one.

recovery.interrupted_pipeline: Parse the state marker, run status and sync, then continue from the validated stage.
recovery.failed_verification: Do not mark Done. Add a Verification Failure comment and keep or move the task In Progress.
recovery.PROJECT_ORCHESTRATION_RECEIPT_AMBIGUOUS: Validate exactly one active receipt and resume one deterministic event.
recovery.PROJECT_ORCHESTRATION_DRIFT: Revision or source drift; refresh bindings before resuming.
recovery.MILESTONE_ORCHESTRATION_RECEIPT_AMBIGUOU: Validate the matching milestone receipt and project scope fence.
recovery.ORCHESTRATION_SCOPE_CONFLICT: Project-scope conflict; resolve scope before resuming.
recovery.HUMAN_VERIFICATION_POLICY_DRIFT: Resolve precedence again, reconcile affected receipts and gate state, then recompute the next event.
recovery.MODEL_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Four failed automatic rounds. Run only one explicitly selected stronger repair, then return to the same gate after any further failure.
recovery.ROLLOVER_DRIFT: Refresh inventory and preview; never complete the source project from a stale receipt.
recovery.external_mutation: Compare with current plans. Ask before reconciling conflicts.
recovery.changed_plans_or_dependencies: Classify bound drift. Safe-refresh only whitelisted plan evidence; material changes expire guarded policy.
recovery.failed_write: Read back to determine whether it applied. Retry once only when safe, then stop.
recovery.missing_blocker: Stop and ask for a valid issue identifier.
recovery.missing_document_capability: Return the draft and the capability gap; do not claim persistence.
